subject: USAGE clause
notes: kb/Work R43 (owner, 2026-09-24): an unsupported facility is unsupported entirely — item 2: a rule HALF inside a declined facility takes its LIVE half's verdict; the declined half (the implied phrase for the standard DECIMAL floating-point usages, and binary128 — A.3 items 17/19) is non-support. a)-c) for FLOAT-BINARY-32/-64 measured on the bytes by the existing goldens. || kb/Work PB579 — a) b) and c) CONFORM for the standard BINARY floating-point usages, measured on the BYTES rather than on a self-inverse round trip. Probe p29 (--std 2023) puts 1.0 in three FLOAT-BINARY-32 items and reads each group's image with FUNCTION ORD: HIGH-ORDER-LEFT gives 64 129 1 1 (0x3F 0x80 0x00 0x00 - big-endian, a), HIGH-ORDER-RIGHT gives 1 1 129 64 (little-endian, b), and no phrase gives big-endian. Probe p30 adds an `OPTIONS. FLOAT-BINARY IS HIGH-ORDER-RIGHT.` paragraph: the phrase-less item becomes little-endian and an item writing HIGH-ORDER-LEFT stays big-endian - c), and the precedence is §11.9.8.3 SR2/SR3's own wording ("in which an endianness-phrase is not specified"), not a preference. The no-OPTIONS default is HIGH-ORDER-LEFT, the documented choice at docs/CONFORMANCE.md §7 item 48 (§11.9.8.3 SR1 leaves it to the implementor). The phrase is refused where the general format does not print it (COBOL1716 on FLOAT-LONG - probe p19) and a repeat is refused (COBOL1718); the whole phrase is COBOL-2014-gated (COBOL0900 at 85/2002 - probe p47). Derivation is centralized: UsageFamilies.IsStandardBinaryFloat / IsStandardDecimalFloat write §3.166/§3.167 down once, PicInfo.FloatItem applies GR19a/b once. PARTIAL FOR TWO REASONS, both of them the reach of the rule rather than its logic: d) - the implied phrase for the standard DECIMAL floating-point usages via §11.9.9 - can never execute, because FLOAT-DECIMAL-16/-34 are not provided (rows GR17/GR18, Annex A.3 item 19), and a) and b) are likewise unreachable for FLOAT-BINARY-128 (row GR16, A.3 item 17), so of the five usages §3.166/§3.167 name only two ever reach GR19's effect. kb/Work PB174 landed the per-item phrase and is closed. || code sites, verbatim from the adjudication: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.cs#DataBinder.BindEntry; src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Model/PicInfo.cs#PicInfo.FloatItem; src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Model/PicInfo.cs#UsageFamilies; src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Grammar/Core/CobolData.g4#floatFormatPhrase; docs/CONFORMANCE.md#DOC-A.1-48
